text_block_list.text:
While I was shopping, I spotted a limited-time flash sale
on a value pack of assorted donuts.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Today's the day I'm definitely snagging that
extra-large variety value pack!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Whoaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...W-W-Well well, what a coincidence!
Running into you in a place like this...!
choice_data_list: Did you come to buy donuts?
Did you come to buy donuts?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A-As if I'd eat childish sweets like that!
I don't even care for sugary stuff anyway!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I told you, an acquaintance asked me to buy this, so I had no choice...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
B-By the way, is your haul a super
megasized assorted pack too?
choice_data_list: No, that amount might be a bit tough...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
B-By the way, is your haul a super
megasized assorted pack too?
choice_data_list: No, that amount might be a bit tough...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Something like that is no big deal—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
True, it might be too much food for one person...
I'll just tell my friends they were sold out.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, I've got things to do.
See ya, later!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Freshly made donuts with soft, fluffy fresh cream...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'll be dreaming of the day... I get to race you again...!

As if trying to shake something off,
Vodka walked away to somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the donuts here are freshly made,
so the whipped cream is super fluffy and freakin' delicious!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...or at least, an acquaintance of mine told me that once!
Ah, ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go buy it together!
If we dilly-dally, it'll sell out.

"After buying the donuts, since we had the chance,
I savored their flavor together with Vodka."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh... How was it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That whipped cream melting right on your tongue
was absolute perfection, wasn't it?!
choice_data_list: I thought you weren't interested in sweets...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Th-That was just my review after eating it!
It's not like I'm hooked on it or anything...!
Despite her words, Vodka ended up devouring the entire super-sized assortment pack in the blink of an eye...
